description: This file contains symbolic definitions for exporting PyTorch operations to ONNX format, specifically for opset 12. It defines functions for various tensor operations such as einsum, outer, dropout, loss functions, argmax/argmin, pow, ge, le, unfold, tensordot, and others, with annotations for symbolic conversion and handling of ONNX graph nodes.
